name: startup-legal
description: Legal groundwork for a startup that can't yet pay a lawyer for everything: an agreement checked before you sign it (blanks, broken cross-references, mismatched amounts, the renewal date, and the clauses that hurt a small company, with wording to ask for), and your cap table modelled through SAFEs, notes and a priced round. Each says what is worth a lawyer's hour. (7 skills, 1 loop)
